title: Cao Cao Floods Xiapi; Lü Bu Dies at the White Gate Tower
summary: Cao Cao dams the Yi and the Si and lets them into the city. Lü Bu, who has stopped drinking and started forbidding it, alienates the last officers he has; they tie him up while he sleeps and open the gate.

At the White Gate Tower he offers to serve — 'you take the infantry, I will take the cavalry, and the empire is yours' — and Cao Cao wavers. He asks Liu Bei's opinion. Liu Bei says four words: 'Remember Ding Yuan and Dong Zhuo.' Lü Bu is strangled.
Chen Gong, offered his life, walks to the executioner without stopping. Zhang Liao curses everyone present and is untied by Cao Cao personally.
history: Historical, including Liu Bei's intervention — the one moment in the novel where his mildness drops entirely and he simply has a man killed.

pins.note: Strangled at the White Gate Tower.
Leaves the novel here without a word.
Curses his captors, and is spared.
